capture.text:
Advancing medicine to save lives. Together.
Thanks to many decades of experience and our passion for what we do, we make an essential contribution to the global availability of biopharmaceuticals, especially for patients with rare and serious diseases.
Rentschler Biopharma SE is a leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) focused exclusively on client projects. We offer customized full-service solutions for bioprocess development and the production of complex biopharmaceuticals. As a German family-owned company with an international footprint and global reach, we combine experts, expertise and years of experience to develop best-in-class solutions – together with our clients.
Rentschler Biopharma has approximately 1,400 employees and is headquartered in Laupheim, Germany, with a site in Milford, MA, USA. In 2024, we joined the United Nations Global Compact, underlining our commitment to sustainability.
As an independent family-owned company, we live by the motto: Many hands, many minds - ONE TEAM! Open, respectful cooperation characterizes our working environment, where quality awareness, diligence and responsibility are our top priorities. With all the diversity of our talents in the Rentschler team, we pursue one vision together: advancing medicine to save lives.
As a member of the Rentschler Biopharma Quality Control leadership team in Milford, the Sr Director Quality Control - Analytics & Product Testing will primarily be responsible for leading a Quality Control team responsible for analytical method qualification/validation, testing incoming samples (including process intermediates, drug substance and/or drug product), and providing timely results that support GxP manufacturing and product disposition. The QC Analytics & Product Testing team is composed of analytical leaders, scientists and QC analysts that cover 7-day per week testing. This role will collaborate with Quality Control Technical Services and Quality Operations Support & Stability staff to periodically evaluate processes to ensure that QC activities are efficient, timely in terms of delivery of client contract deliverables, and safeguard data integrity. The successful candidate will need to be flexible and agile with the ability to pivot quickly to changing circumstances and business needs.
Duties and Responsibilities
Lead QC Analytics & Product Testing team and laboratory activities
Hire and develop employees within the department, while setting clear expectations for success
Provide active feedback, coaching and employee development
Act as Portfolio manager for QC project work including scheduling, prioritizing and resource planning to ensure client contract deliverables are met
Oversee analytical method transfer and method validation activities – requiring in-depth understanding of protein chemistry and analytical chemistry methodologies (incl. peptide mapping, glycan analysis, SEC-HPLC, IEX-HPLC, potency analysis by chromogenic assay)
Participate in Milford Site Quality Leadership team meetings and follow up action plans
Collaborate within QC to support authoring, review and/or approval of QC related documents ensuring all appropriate documents are generated and retrievable per GMP standards in support of regulatory submissions and inspections
Support the team in managing OOS/OOT investigations, deviations and change controls, and implementing appropriate CAPA as it relates to QC
Provides representation in customer and authority audits and implementation of resulting corrective measures
Responsible for supporting operational aspects of the QC Analytics laboratory, including data verification, PO management, records management, etc.
Drives continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity and efficiency within QC
Collect and report quality control metrics via Quality Management Reviews and the Quality Council
Consistently advise site and Quality management of potential and actual actions that could adversely affect the business; represent quality exposures or represent opportunities to be pursued
Promotes a strong Quality Culture based on the Rentschler core values
Qualifications
A bachelor's or master's degree in chemistry, biochemistry or a related life science field with substantial hands-on experience in Quality Control related activities
18+ years of industry experience in a GMP QC environment, with a minimum of 8+ years of managerial and project management experience
Leadership skills to manage technical and laboratory personnel
Strong sense of accountability, self-motivation, and drive in meeting project objectives
Direct experience in managing and overseeing QC related activities internally and at third party vendors
Understanding of FDA/EU/ICH regulations and guidance related to critical quality attributes, release testing, analytical validation and transfer, and stability testing
Proven ability to lead and implement multiple projects/tasks simultaneously with competing and/or changing priorities ensuring effective time management
Excellent facilitation and project management skills, with strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to effectively communicate across all levels and cross-functional teams
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment
Working Conditions
Normal office working conditions: computer, phone, files, fax, copier
Personal Protective Equipment must be worn as required
Minimum travel required
Will interact with other people
Pace may be fast and job completion demands may be high
Working Conditions
PPE as required
____________________________________________________________________________ Base Pay Range
$210,000 - $260,000
Disclosure Statement
Rentschler Biopharma, Inc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base pay range listed for this position is the anticipated annual base salary range the organization reasonably, and in good faith, expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other application factors permissible by law. The annual base salary is just one component of our Total Rewards package, which also includes our annual discretionary bonus program, medical insurance, our generous 401K program, plus a host of other benefits to aligned to support our employees’ personal and professional wellness. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.

Job Description
General Summary:
The Sr. Director, GCP Operational Quality will advance and provide strategic direction and oversight of the strategies, mechanisms, processes and capabilities for effective and proactive quality risk management across respective product/therapeutic program area(s) (e.g.; Cystic Fibrosis). This individual will serve as the GCP Operational Quality Lead and have overall responsibility for lifecycle review of risks to quality through ensuring appropriate oversight, mitigation strategies and plans enabling clinical quality outcomes and real time inspection readiness. This individual will provide strategic oversight and leadership for Quality Management Reviews, ensuring transparency for gaining insights regarding effectiveness of risk mitigation strategies/controls, proactive and sustainable clinical quality, and compliance for assigned programs. This individual will integrate end-to-end quality principles and review preparedness at key milestones in alignment with organizational and project milestones. The Sr. Director, GCP Operational Quality will foster strong collaboration and partnership with business stakeholders and will ensure alignment with Quality leadership and teams (e.g. audit, vendor management) in development of integrated strategies for clinical programs, process and vendor oversight, inspection readiness, and assurance. This individual will provide strategic guidance and direction to the integrated benchmarking and external environmental monitoring for identifying emerging industry trends and best practices (e.g. operating models, capabilities) to facilitate maximum value to evaluation of the health of the quality system and identification of cross functional risks that will require assessment by the GXP functional areas. The Sr. Director, GCP Operational Quality will be one who has demonstrated success in engaging clinical/medical teams and cross-functional stakeholders for collaboration in applying quality risk management approaches (e.g. Quality by Design) for inspection readiness, quality outcomes and operational excellence, balancing design of models with practicality of application for effectiveness of outcomes.
Key Duties and Responsibilities:
Provides strategic direction and oversight to development, execution and continual improvement of quality risk management/mitigation and inspection readiness strategies across program areas
Design program-specific Quality strategy and partner with business stakeholders across Global Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, etc. for alignment of quality strategies, goals and approaches in support of quality outcomes and real time inspection readiness
Provides strategic leadership to implementation of risk-based approaches to quality for clinical development program(s) – e.g. Quality by Design principles, risk-based quality management (RBQM) and ensure effectiveness of mechanisms for ongoing quality risk monitoring, mitigation and management
Provides strategic oversight and ensures development, implementation and maintenance of the quality plan(s) summarizing the result of evidence of quality activities
Leads and/or provides strategic direction/oversight to staff leading quality working groups to define integrated quality plans/activities to deliver the overall quality strategy across QA functions (e.g. audit, operations, vendor management, inspection preparedness and management, etc.)
Engages and provides consultation to business partners in advancing proactive and leading quality approaches incorporating best practices and establishing/developing strategies for new models, technologies, and practices across clinical development
Serves as Quality representative to cross-functional clinical development teams, R&D Leadership and quality governance bodies as applicable
Manages for cause, critical and/or complex quality issues for Strategic leadership of proactive inspection readiness strategies and review at key project milestones in support of organizational deliverables and decision-making models
Provides strategic direction in the oversight and continual advancement of the GCP QMS framework/model for optimizing operational performance across QA and the business areas as well as in collaboration with the Integrated QMS function in QA
Leads/chairs integrated GCP QA Operational Management Reviews for ensuring cross-QA transparency and gaining insights regarding efficiency, inspection readiness, and operational performance across QA, including identification of opportunities for improvement
Partners with QA leadership and managers for determination of needs for tools, metrics, mechanisms and systems enabling individual manager accountability and ownership for decision making in ensuring operational performance (budget, resource, goals/objectives) across their scope of responsibility
Provides expertise and strategic oversight and direction to development and advancement of progressive models and mechanisms for risk management identification, mitigation and communications across QA supporting enhanced planning, prioritization, resourcing strategies and projection of future needs and capabilities
Provides leadership coordination and direction to benchmarking with external peers and industry for establishing QA operational performance targets/goals in support of excellence, value and impact
Provides leadership and partners with QA management in proactive and strategic planning for QA and translation of the strategy to operating plans for execution
Partners with stakeholders across enabling functions for alignment of strategies, and optimization of programs for delivery, specifically with respect to corporate vs. QA-specific initiatives
Knowledge and Skills:
Broad and deep global health regulatory agency knowledge and experience across multiple GCP/PV with current knowledge of industry trends and best practices for efficiency, compliance and effectiveness
Knowledge and demonstrated experience in application of risk-based quality principles (e.g. QbD) in a pharmaceutical environment
Broad and deep operational and project management knowledge and experience
Demonstrated strategic planning and execution skills required
Proven ability to design/evolve and /or implement quality strategies and operational planning and oversight in a fit-for-purpose manner enabling effectiveness, flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic and evolving business model
Current knowledge of industry trends and best practices- for progressive quality risk management in a regulated environment
Developing individuals and teams; proven leadership capabilities within multi-level organization
Creative, innovative leadership experience complemented with strong change management experience, adaptability, resourcefulness
Excellent communication skills and a proven track record Influencing/building/promoting a culture of Quality and Excellence
Operational Excellence experience with proven ability to lead improvement projects-Experience with implementation and execution of program and enterprise risk management, Root Cause Analysis and other Operational Excellence experience, such as LEAN, DMAIC, Six Sigma
Strong problem solving and critical thinking skills, accompanied by Analytical thinking/Data Analysis skills required to make sound decisions
Education and Experience:
M.S. (or equivalent degree) and 10 +years of relevant work experience, or
B.S. in a scientific or allied health field (or equivalent degree) and 15+ years of relevant work experience, or relevant comparable background

Job Description
Senior Director, Quality Data, Digital Systems & Compliance
GxP Data Governance • Data Integrity • Master Data • Computer Systems Assurance • Quality Analytics
General position summary:
The Senior Director, Quality Data, Digital Systems & Compliance, serves as a pivotal leader within the Quality organization. This role provides strategic vision and direction to advance frameworks, strengthen organizational capabilities, and scale models and operations across GxP Data Integrity, Data Governance, Quality Analytics, and Digital Systems Compliance (CSA/CSV) oversight. The position promotes leading practices, supports organizational growth, and enables adaptation to evolving industry expectations as well as advanced and emerging technologies.
This role is responsible for establishing and sustaining a robust framework for GxP data integrity, master data management, computerized systems compliance (CSV/CSA), and quality analytics to ensure regulatory compliance, inspection readiness, and data-driven decision-making. Serving as a key partner to Quality, IT, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Clinical, and business stakeholders, this leader enables effective oversight, governance and stewardship of the organization's GxP quality data.
The ideal candidate will possess senior-level leadership and change management skills, extensive data integrity, governance, management and reporting expertise with demonstrated ability to implement fit-for-purpose and progressive approaches in a dynamic, innovative and scaling organization.
Key Responsibilities:
GxP Quality Data Governance and Data Integrity Leadership:
Advance, scale and mature the enterprise GxP Data Governance framework, policies, standards, and procedures.
Provide strategic leadership and direction to GxP Data Integrity program aligned with ALCOA+ principles and global regulatory expectations.
Chair cross-functional data governance forums and ensure clear accountability for data ownership and stewardship.
Master Data Management (MDM) Leadership:
Provide strategic direction and owns the model and oversight for quality-related master data across GxP functions.
Embed the GxP MDM Model across the QMS with strategic leadership and championing data ownership, stewardship, for ensuring scalability, continuous improvement of master data quality and scalable lifecycle management processes.
Provide strategic direction and govern data catalogs, business glossaries, data standards, and data lineage.
Data Quality Management Leadership and Strategic Direction:
Define GxP enterprise data quality standards, metrics, controls, and monitoring processes.
Embed and mature proactive data quality surveillance and remediation programs.
Embed, scale and mature risk-based approaches for monitoring critical-to-quality data.
Ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, traceability, and fitness for intended use
CSV/CSA & Computer Systems Quality Oversight:
Provide strategic Quality oversight of computerized systems supporting GxP activities.
Ensure compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and global computerized systems requirements.
Govern validation/assurance methodologies, lifecycle management, and periodic review processes.
Partner with DTE, quality and business leadership and stakeholders on GxP-enabling implementation, upgrades, integrations, digital capabilities, and solutions.
Maintain inspection readiness for computerized systems and data integrity controls.
Quality Analytics and Business Intelligence
Partner with quality and business leadership to craft and refine the vision for quality data analytics and governance to provide real-time insight into GxP compliance, process performance and resource utilization.
Set the strategic vision and drive development and maintenance of data models, reporting systems, data dashboards, descriptive, investigative and predictive analytics, and performance metrics to support quality delivery and organizational decision making.
Define and drive a structured and nimble approach for ongoing and timely translation of data into
Quality Leadership, Enterprise Partnership, Change Management and Quality Culture Championship:
Role models Quality Leadership, serving as a visible leader, advocating quality culture, and ensuring accountability, transparency, and integrity in how quality decisions are made and communicated across the enterprise
Partner with QA leadership and enabling enterprise functions (e.g., Finance, Strategic Sourcing, Human Resources) in proactive management and strategic planning and translation into operating standards, inspection readiness, compliance and excellence
Lead, develop, and mentor quality professionals to mature the capabilities and leadership needed to scale and transform the organization and QMS across a diverse portfolio of products, technologies, geographies, and evolving business needs. Serve as change agent for transformation initiatives, including digitization and advanced technology integration across the QMS
Education level and/or relevant experience(s):
Required:
BS, MS, JD, MD, or PhD in a Life Sciences, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Quality discipline or equivalent. Fifteen (15) years relevant work experience with 7 years leadership supervisory role in a global organization.
Operational/Quality experience (e.g., GMP, GCP, IT). Experience working across business/operational functions in a regulated environment and at an enterprise level preferred.
Experience building sustainable and advanced data integrity, computer systems assurance strategies, advanced analytics, and data governance driving proactive quality management and digital/data insights enabled predictive models.
In-depth knowledge in the following areas:
Required:
Strategic leadership across data integrity/governance and Computer Systems Assurance (CSA/CSV) programs and operations, including data quality, master data management, metadata, and governance frameworks
Advanced analytics, business intelligence, risk management, and data-driven decision-making leadership
Proven ability to lead digital transformation, organizational change, and process modernization initiatives. Exceptional cross-functional leadership, stakeholder engagement, and influencing skills
Strong governance, risk management, and inspection readiness experience
Highly collaborative and effective at building strong enterprise and cross-functional relationships; a strategic change leader who delivers results through influence, partnership, and leadership.
Comfortable in a demanding, fast-paced, patient-focused environment with a start-up culture and evolving processes; flexible and able to adapt as business needs change.
Hands-on, action-oriented leader willing to roll up their sleeves, with the flexibility to adapt to a start-up environment.

Head of Quality
Whisper Aero
Nashville, TN
Our Company
Whisper Aero is pioneering a more compelling and connected future by delivering cleaner, quieter, and more efficient propulsion solutions. Today's open rotor propulsion systems are challenged by safety, noise, and performance limitations at all scales. Whisper's breakthrough technologies allow aircraft to fly anywhere at any time without disturbing communities, at greater speeds, and with incredible improvements in efficiency and cost. Their innovations also enable a new generation of air moving products that can blend into the soundscapes of daily life. Whisper was founded by industry veterans, Mark Moore and Ian Villa, and continues to innovate a future that's as considerate as it is compelling with its world-class team in Tennessee.
About The Role
We are seeking a hands-on Head of Quality to build and lead Whisper Aero's enterprise quality organization as we scale from rapid product development and prototype builds into certified, repeatable production. This executive leader will own the company-wide quality strategy, Quality Management System (QMS), product and manufacturing quality, supplier quality, customer quality, and regulatory compliance. The role will partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, Programs, and Finance to embed quality from concept through sustainment, develop a high-performing team, and ensure that safety, reliability, speed, and cost are managed as an integrated operating system.
What You'll Do
Set and execute the enterprise quality vision, operating model, multi-year roadmap, and resource plan in alignment with company and product objectives.
Serve as the senior quality authority and management representative for customers, regulators, certification bodies, and executive leadership.
Lead, coach, and scale a multidisciplinary organization spanning product, manufacturing, supplier, systems, inspection, and customer quality.
Establish clear decision rights, escalation mechanisms, and quality gates across development, NPI, production, delivery, and field support.
Own the company quality management review, enterprise risk portfolio, and executive reporting cadence.
Enterprise Quality Leadership & Quality Management System
Mature and scale the existing AS9100-certified QMS from prototype-focused processes to rate production, aligned with customer requirements and 14 CFR Part 21 quality system requirements.
Own quality policy, objectives, management review, internal and external audits, document and records control, corrective action, configuration assurance, and organizational learning.
Translate quality data into business decisions through leading and lagging indicators, including first-pass yield, defect and escape rates, cost of poor quality, supplier performance, CAPA effectiveness, and process capability.
Product, Manufacturing & Operational Quality
Embed quality planning in product architecture and design reviews through requirements flow-down, DFMEA, verification and validation, configuration control, and design-for-manufacturability.
Lead quality execution from prototype and NPI through production readiness, rate ramp, customer delivery, and sustainment.
Establish APQP-based mechanisms including process flows, PFMEAs, control plans, Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA), SPC, process qualification and validation, inspection and test strategies, FAI/PPAP, and acceptance criteria.
Own MRB governance, containment, root-cause and corrective action, deviation and nonconformance control, and recurrence prevention without compromising safety or compliance.
Partner with Operations to improve yield, reliability, traceability, automation, and process capability while scaling production responsibly.
Supplier & Customer Quality
Establish supplier quality strategy, requirements, selection criteria, qualification, surveillance, development, and performance management across the supply base.
Lead supplier audits, source and receiving inspection strategy, FAI/PPAP, process capability reviews, SCARs, and recovery plans for critical suppliers.
Represent Quality in customer reviews, contract and requirement flow-down, acceptance, investigations, corrective actions, and delivery readiness.
Create closed-loop mechanisms that translate supplier, factory, test, and field signals into preventive action and product improvement.
Regulatory, Certification & Risk Governance
Own readiness for AS9100D certification and compliance with applicable FAA, customer, contractual, and export-controlled aerospace and defense requirements.
Lead quality engagement with the FAA, customers, registrars, and third-party auditors, including findings, corrective actions, and sustained effectiveness.
Establish enterprise product and process risk governance, independent escalation, stop-work authority, and transparent executive communication for significant quality or safety issues.
Ensure effective supplier control, configuration and document control, records management, calibration, traceability, nonconformance handling, and production acceptance.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of progressive quality, manufacturing, product, or supplier quality experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, automotive, medical device, or another complex regulated hardware environment.
5+ years leading managers and multidisciplinary quality teams, including organizational design, hiring, coaching, budgeting, and resource planning.
Demonstrated ownership of an AS9100D- or ISO 9001-based QMS and successful leadership of certification, customer, or regulatory audits.
Proven experience scaling hardware from development and NPI through stable production, using APQP, FMEA, control plans, MSA, SPC, PPAP/FAI, RCCA/CAPA, and MRB.
Executive-level communication, sound risk judgment, and a record of influencing Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Programs, and senior leadership.
Preferred Qualifications
Direct experience with FAA production approval and 14 CFR Part 21 quality system requirements.
Experience building a quality organization and digital QMS in a fast-growing, vertically integrated technology or aerospace startup.
Experience with high-rate or automated production of complex electromechanical, propulsion, aerospace, or safety-critical products.
ASQ CQE, CMQ/OE, CSQP, AS9100 Lead Auditor, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification.
Master's degree in Engineering, Operations, or Business Administration.
Strong command of ERP, PLM, MES, eQMS, business intelligence, and statistical analysis tools.

Top-tier Benefits: Employee-first focused comprehensive benefits package, minimum of 90% employer-paid plans for employees and dependents with optional HSA/FSA account offerings
PTO & Federal Holidays: Starting at four weeks of paid time off for vacation, sick, and personal days
Competitive Salary: Value-based compensation, plus enjoy Tennessee's no-income-tax life
End of Year Bonuses: For eligible employees
We always have beverages and snacks available to energize you throughout the day, with paid team meals based on office demands.
401(k)

Job Details: Job Location: #903 Corporate Illinois Cafe & Service Company - Des Plaines, IL, Position Type: Full Time, Salary Range: $110000.00 - $120000.00Salary, Reporting:
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
Direct Reports:
Area Manager(s)
Leadership Scope:
Provides leadership and oversight to all Operations team members, including Senior Multi-Unit Managers, Multi-Unit Managers, Hourly Managers, and Guest Service Hosts.
Description:
The Vice President of Operations is the steward of our organizational identity, bridging the field and support center teams. They spend time in the field listening to frontline employees, then bring those insights to the executive table to shape decisions. In turn, they translate corporate priorities into clear, purposeful action for each location following the principles of Unreasonable Hospitality.
More than anything, they are the guardian of what makes us us: the values, traditions, and shared ways of working that bind our people together. They ensure those values are felt in every location by recognizing great work, modeling expected behaviors, and making sure every employee feels seen, heard, and proud to belong.
This role has two main objectives: setting and executing the company’s operational strategy across its retail video gaming (VGT) locations, and building and leading the Operations leadership team. It requires a service-oriented, strategic, and results-driven executive who prioritizes guest satisfaction while ensuring smooth, compliant, and profitable operations that support the company’s long-term growth.
Expectations:
Lead with integrity and honesty in all work-related duties and set the standard for the organization.
Provide proactive, strategic leadership over the operations of all company locations.
Empower and support the Operations team to meet or exceed performance standards.
Maintain a deep working knowledge of every area of operations and step in to assist when necessary.
Develop a positive and collaborative work environment for employees, guests, vendors, and regulators.
Ensure the company meets state, local, and company standards and regulations, including gaming and liquor requirements.
Maintain clear and consistent communication with the CEO, executive team, employees, managers, and stakeholders.
Qualifications: Responsibilities:
Executive Leadership and Culture
Serve as a trusted advisor to the executive team and participate in setting company vision, strategy, and annual goals.
Be a champion of company culture by leading with integrity, kindness, and a strong commitment to company values.
Foster a mentor mentality by teaching and leading by example, asking questions to ensure clarity, and consistently following up to reinforce learning and ensure progress.
Build, coach, and hold accountable the Operations team.
Lead succession planning and talent development across all levels of operations leadership.
Provide regular operational and financial updates to the executive team.
Operations and Guest Experience
Take ownership of operations across all locations and establish company-wide standards for guest service, cleanliness, and sanitation.
Teach, demonstrate, and guide the organization toward exceptional guest service, creating memorable experiences every shift, every day, every time.
Drive operational efficiency through impactful leadership and accountability at all levels, identifying opportunities and resolving challenges to ensure smooth, continuous operations.
Establish and monitor operating procedures for inventory, ordering, scheduling, timecards, and store audits, and verify they are consistently followed.
Be knowledgeable of VGT machines, slot games, and features, and ensure teams are equipped to resolve machine issues.
Evaluate and implement process improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across locations.
People Management
Partner with Human Resources to ensure proper staffing levels, training and development of team members, disciplinary actions, and overall performance management.
Establish compensation, staffing, and labor-budget guidelines for operations in partnership with the CEO and Human Resources.
Maintain consistent communication with all levels of the organization, including in-person visits, camera monitoring, phone calls, and team meetings.
Facilitate regular meetings with the Area Manager(s), Operations team, and business partners to ensure thorough follow-through on all business needs.
Support a culture of continuous training and development for new and existing team members.
Financial Performance
Own the company's operating P&L, including VGT performance and controllable expenses, ensuring results stay within budget while driving profitability.
Develop annual operating budgets, and capital plans in partnership with the CEO and CFO.
Analyze monthly P&Ls and key performance indicators and hold the leadership team accountable for results.
Ensure strong internal controls over cash handling, deposit processes, and sales activities across all locations.
Licensing, Compliance, and Regulatory Relations
Oversee the company's licensing and compliance program to ensure adherence to state and local regulations and standards.
Serve as a key point of contact with regulators, including the Illinois Gaming Board (IGB), and maintain professional relationships with regulatory and local authorities.
Uphold company policies and licensing standards, including liquor and gaming regulations, to protect employees and guests.
Ensure a safe and compliant work environment by following local health codes and business license regulations.
Ensure all employees complete required certification courses and that audits are completed and corrective actions are followed through.
Reinforce a zero-tolerance standard to prohibit underage patrons from purchasing alcohol or gambling by IDing every guest, every time.
Growth, Market Strategy, and Marketing
Identify and evaluate opportunities for growth, including new locations and market expansion.
Analyze each local market through competitive shops, daily reports, and monthly revenue reports from the IGB.
Champion marketing initiatives and promotional campaigns, ensuring effective implementation across all locations.
Provide strategic direction to the leadership team to drive successful marketing initiatives and promotions.
Safety, Security, and Systems
Maintain a safe working environment by overseeing safety programs, ensuring concerns are reported and resolved.
Ensure key and alarm code tracking, camera monitoring, and security procedures are followed at all locations.
Ensure internal systems such as ShiftNotes, Guardian, and the Point-of-Sale system are maintained and updated.
Facilities, Vendors, and Risk Management
Oversee repair and maintenance programs to ensure equipment, facilities, and systems operate efficiently.
Take a proactive approach to identifying and addressing operational risk before problems escalate.
Manage key vendor, contractor, and partner relationships, including negotiating and reviewing service agreements in partnership with the CEO.
Other Duties
Perform other duties as requested by the CEO.
Skills & Experience:
Must be 21 years of age.
Extensive multi-unit or multi-location leadership experience, including leading managers and directors.
Experience in gaming, hospitality, restaurant, or retail operations is preferred.
Proven track record of owning a P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and driving profitable growth.
Working knowledge of gaming and liquor regulations, including Illinois Gaming Board requirements, strongly preferred.
Strong executive presence with excellent communication, interpersonal, and team leadership skills.
Must have access to reliable transportation and be available to travel to all locations during business hours.
Must be able to bend, reach, lift, and/or carry 50 pounds.
Must be able to maintain an active and engaged floor presence for periods exceeding 60 minutes.
Attend meetings and trainings as required.
